findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`. Any read path relying on this authorization gate can therefore permit cross-tenant document access. Preserve the tenant-equality check or replace it with an equivalent authorization policy.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body:
Any user whose tenant differs from a document’s tenant now receives `true`, allowing unauthorized cross-tenant document access wherever this authorization function gates reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a target document’s `documentTenant` can pass this check and read cross-tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
